clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, a Bundle of Hides travels toward Thunder Bluff with the Horde’s wind riders. The cured skins are a straightforward courier shipment for the leatherworkers, and their delivery introduces travelers to the wind rider network.

Hunters skin the beasts of the Barrens for cured hides. The plains hold vast herds of kodo, prowling lions, and roving raptors. These skins supply the leatherworkers of Thunder Bluff, who turn them into gear, pouches, armor, and bindings for the Horde.

Couriers carry the bundle from the Crossroads to Thunder Bluff on Devrak’s trained wyverns. Overland travel through the Barrens and into Mulgore is slow and dangerous, with roaming quilboar and centaur raiders. Handing the hides to a wind rider courier shows how swiftly air travel can cross Kalimdor’s fractured terrain.
